sections.heading: Adobe Marketo Engage limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Growth with exit criteria before annual seats.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Adobe Marketo Engage
sections.body:

Implementation time: weeks to configure social scheduling if Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Adobe Experience Cloud must be green before invites.
